_comment: AD-072 (knock-out 2026-11-17): one short plain-English hint and an example for every field in the PQC Forge dashboard. Key = <Component>.<field>. Post-quantum readiness wording only; never 'quantum-safe' or 'quantum-proof'.

ConnectPanel.signupBaseUrl.hint: The address of the PQC Forge API you are signing up on. Leave it as shown unless you run your own copy.

ConnectPanel.signupName.hint: Your company or team name. It appears on your workspace and reports.

ConnectPanel.signupEmail.hint: Optional. Only used to reach you about your account; no newsletter.

ConnectPanel.keyBaseUrl.hint: The address of the PQC Forge API your key belongs to.

ConnectPanel.apiKey.hint: The tenant API key shown once when you signed up. It stays in this browser tab only.

BillingTab.buyerCountry.hint: The country you are buying from, so the right tax is applied at checkout.

BillingTab.proQuantity.hint: How many repositories the Pro plan should cover (1 to 500).

ReportTab.organization.hint: The name printed on the signed report cover.

ReportTab.endpoints.hint: Up to 10 public hosts to check live for post-quantum key exchange, one per line. A host that does not answer is reported as Not verified.

ReportTab.dataLifetimeYears.hint: How many years the data this code protects must stay confidential. Longer lifetimes move key-exchange and encryption findings up the plan (signatures are not affected).

ScanTab.noIgnore.hint: Tick to include findings your team marked as audited exceptions, for a full picture.

MigrateTab.write.hint: Off, the migration only shows what it would change (dry run). On, it writes the changes to your workspace.

MigrateTab.acknowledgeRuntime.hint: Confirm the servers that will run this config support the X25519MLKEM768 hybrid key exchange; required before writing.

VerifyTlsTab.target.hint: A public host and port to check for post-quantum key exchange in TLS 1.3.

VerifyTlsTab.insecure.hint: Skip the certificate check, only for self-signed or staging hosts. The key-exchange result is still real.

ReceiptTab.receiptJson.hint: Paste a signed receipt or readiness report (JSON). It is checked against the keys this server publishes.

WorkspaceEditor.example.hint: Load a ready-made example workspace to try the tools without your own code.

WorkspaceEditor.filePath.hint: The file's path inside the workspace; the scanner uses the extension to pick its rules.

WorkspaceEditor.fileContent.hint: Paste the file's content. It is scanned for classical-only cryptography.

BreakLabTab.budget.hint: How many attempts the lab makes before it stops.

BreakLabTab.seed.hint: A number that makes a run repeatable: the same seed gives the same result.

BreakLabGridTab.paceMs.hint: Delay between steps in milliseconds, so you can watch the grid fill.
